in_hindi.meaning: मल्ला (Malla) + पा (Appa) = वृद्ध बाप (Vriddha Baap) or पिता (Pita) in Hindi
in_hindi.long_meaning: An old father or a respectful term for a father in Hindi

in_tamil.meaning: மல்லா (Malla) + பா (Appa) = அதிகாரி (Adhikari) or தமிழ் பாத்திரம் (Tamil Pattiram) for father in Tamil
in_tamil.long_meaning: An authority figure or a term of respect for a father in Tamil

in_marathi.name: Mallappa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Death, Lord of Yama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mallappa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mallappa is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Maha' meaning great and 'Lap' meaning death. In Hindu mythology, Mallappa is considered as the Lord of Yama, the Hindu god of death. He is also known as Maha-Yama or Yama Raja.
